Team — quick reminder as we head into final submission week for Q4. I pulled a lightweight checklist to keep the last-mile pass focused and avoid churn on the day of submission. Anne / Sam — sharing so you can see our timeline and flag anything that looks off on your side.

Top asks (please do these by EOD Sun Oct 13 in the attached template):
- Update your top 10 deals in the Q4_submission_template.xlsx (column: probability, expected close date, blockers).
- Add any recent legal/procurement redlines to column F; use "procurement" tag where relevant.
- Mark deals you believe should be counted as "commit" in the last column (yes/no) and add one short line reason.
- Upload the acme_deal_flags.csv if you change stage flags or add escalations.

Pre-call (Mon Oct 14, 09:15 PT) — 15 minutes:
1) Quick readout: deals moving into commit (2 minutes)
2) Risk register: top 3 at-risk accounts (5 minutes)
3) Final SLAs for submission + who hits submit (3 minutes)
4) Any downstream handoffs/questions (5 minutes)

Attachments: Q4_submission_template.xlsx, acme_deal_flags.csv
Dial-in: https://meet.redwood.com/forecasting/mon-oct14-0915

If you think any deal needs an escalation thread ahead of Monday, start one now and cc: me. Thanks — keeping this tight will save cycles on the submission day.

— Jonas

Thanks for the fast updates. Final prep notes before we join: please see short agenda and owner list below. I stamped who submits at the bottom.

Agenda (strict 15m):
- 09:15 — 09:17 (2m) | Commit callouts (Marissa) — list deals moving into commit
- 09:17 — 09:22 (5m) | Top 3 risks & mitigation (Karthik) — highlight ACME-58 retention ask + any blockers
- 09:22 — 09:25 (3m) | Submission mechanics (Laura) — confirm who clicks submit; HubSpot / internal sync
- 09:25 — 09:30 (5m) | Handoffs and notes (Logan) — CS & Finance actions post-submit

Who submits: Laura Bennett will make the final submission and confirm receipt in HubSpot.

Quick rules of engagement:
- If legal sign-off is expected within 7 days of the close date, treat as "commit" but annotate "conditional-legal" in the notes.
- If procurement has an open negotiation on contract terms that changes core T&Cs, move to "best_case" until resolved.
- Use the confidence band (High/Med/Low) + percent for quick triage; the band is primary for risk calls.

Attachments included in this thread: Q4_submission_template.xlsx, acme_deal_flags.csv
Dial-in: https://meet.redwood.com/forecasting/mon-oct14-0915 (same link)

Anne / Sam — if anything on your side changes during the call, let Marissa know and we'll capture it in the flags file immediately. See you in 5.
